baseUrl.description: astramem-local daemon base URL. Defaults to the ASTRAMEM_BASE_URL env var, then http://127.0.0.1:7777.

bearer.description: Bearer token for the daemon (its MEMORY_BEARER secret). Defaults to the ASTRAMEM_BEARER env var.

projectId.description: Explicit project scope applied to captured/recalled memories. Defaults to a value derived from the OpenClaw channel/session when omitted.

profileEveryNTurns.description: How often (in turns) to inject the agent's astramem profile block. Default 50.

captureEnabled.description: Enable after-turn auto-capture into astramem. Default true.

recallEnabled.description: Enable before-turn auto-recall from astramem. Default true.

recallK.description: Max memories to recall per turn. Default 5.
